core_obligations: Reduction: pseudo-coherence and local finite tor dimension are local properties, so it suffices to prove: for X and S affine, E is S-perfect iff K = RGamma(X, E) is O_S(S)-perfect; write X = Spec(A), S = Spec(R), E corresponds to K by the affine comparison (proof lines 8966-8973).

Affine equivalence: K is R-perfect iff K is pseudo-coherent and has finite tor dimension over R, by the More on Algebra definition; by the affine pseudo-coherence lemma E is pseudo-coherent iff K is, and by the relative tor-dimension affine lemma E has finite tor dimension over f^{-1}O_S iff K has finite tor dimension over R (proof lines 8976-8986).
Conclude the equivalence of (1), (2), and (3) from the affine case and locality (statement).
proof_roadmap: Reduce to the affine case by locality of the two defining properties (proof lines 8966-8970).
Translate both conditions of relative perfectness to the module complex K (proof lines 8971-8986).
Assemble the three equivalent statements from locality and the affine equivalence.
